ShellConfig.description:
Shell configuration for custom execution environments.

Used when commands need to run in a custom shell (e.g., Docker container).
When `heredoc` is true, commands are passed via stdin with `set -e` for
error handling.

Example:
```yaml
shell:
  invoke: "docker_tool vivado-2023.2"
  heredoc: true
  mount_repo_root: true
  options:
    - "--pull=never"
```

heredoc.description: Use heredoc/stdin mode. Commands passed via stdin with 'set -e'.
heredoc.title: Heredoc

invoke.description: Command to start the shell (e.g., 'docker_tool vivado-2023.2')
invoke.title: Invoke

mount_repo_root.description: Mount repository root into container. Adds '--volume {repo_root}:{repo_root}' to options.
mount_repo_root.title: Mount Repo Root

options.description: Additional options passed to the shell command after '--'. For docker_tool: docker/podman options like '--pull=never'.
options.title: Options

ShellConfig.title: ShellConfig

ToolExecutor.description:
Configuration for executing a specific tool version.

Defines how to execute a tool (e.g., Vivado) and related utilities
(like hdldepends) for a specific version. Supports both local
installations and containerised environments.

The execution flow is: [shell] → [setup] → [injected commands] → [executable]

Example:
```yaml
tools:
  vivado:
    # Local installation
    "2020.1":
      setup:
        - "source /tools/Xilinx/Vivado/2020.1/settings64.sh"
      executable: "vivado"

    # Docker container with heredoc and repo mounting
    "2023.2":
      shell:
        invoke: "docker_tool vivado-2023.2"
        heredoc: true
        mount_repo_root: true
        options:
          - "--pull=never"
      setup:
        - "source /opt/Xilinx/Vivado/2023.2/settings64.sh"
        - 'REPO_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"'
        - 'source "${REPO_ROOT}/venv/bin/activate"'
      executable: "vivado"
```

setup.description: Setup commands to run first (e.g., source settings.sh). Executed before any injected commands like hdldepends.
setup.title: Setup

shell.description: Custom shell configuration. If not set, uses /bin/bash with && chaining. Use this for Docker or other containerised environments.

ToolExecutor.title: ToolExecutor

GlobalConfiguration.description:
Global repository configuration (`hdlproject_global_config.yaml`).

Located at repository root. Settings can be overridden at project level.

Example:
```yaml
project_dir: "fw/prj"
hdldepends_config: "hdldepends.json"
default_cores: 2
max_parallel_builds: 4
compile_order_format: "json"

tools:
  vivado:
    "2020.1":
      setup:
        - "source /tools/Xilinx/Vivado/2020.1/settings64.sh"
      executable: "vivado"
    "2023.2":
      shell:
        invoke: "docker_tool vivado-2023.2"
        heredoc: true
      setup:
        - "source /opt/Xilinx/Vivado/2023.2/settings64.sh"
      executable: "vivado"
```

compile_order_format.description: Output format for compile order files ('json' or 'tcl').
compile_order_format.title: Compile Order Format

default_cores.description: Default CPU cores per project for synthesis/implementation.
default_cores.title: Default Cores

hdldepends_config.description: Default hdldepends config path, relative to repository root. Overridable per-project.
hdldepends_config.title: Hdldepends Config

max_parallel_builds.description: Maximum parallel builds. If None, calculated from system resources.
max_parallel_builds.title: Max Parallel Builds

project_dir.description: Base directory containing project directories, relative to repository root.
project_dir.title: Project Dir

tools.description: Tool execution configs keyed by tool name then version. e.g., tools.vivado.'2020.1'. Overridable per-project.
tools.title: Tools

GlobalConfiguration.title: GlobalConfiguration

BlockDesign.description:
Block design configuration.

Example:
```yaml
block_designs:
  - file: processing_system.bd
    commands:
      - "regenerate_bd_layout"
      - "validate_bd_design"
```

commands.description: Additional TCL commands to execute after loading.
commands.title: Commands

file.description: Path to block design file (.tcl or .bd), relative to config file.
file.title: File

BlockDesign.title: BlockDesign

BuildConfiguration.description:
Build-time configuration for synthesis and implementation.

These are persistent options stored in the config, distinct from
CLI runtime options like --cores or --clean.

Example:
```yaml
build_configuration:
  artefact_name: "{{ project_information.project_name | upper }}_v{{ build_variables.version_major }}"
  build_variables:
    version_major:
      value: 1
    version_minor:
      value: 0
    git_hash:
      command: "git rev-parse --short HEAD"
  generated_sources:
    - template: "hdl/build_info_pkg.vhd.j2"
  write_hw_platform:
    include_bit: true
```

artefact_name.description: Jinja2 template string for the build artefact name. Rendered with the full resolved config and build variables as context.
artefact_name.title: Artefact Name

build_variables.description: Build-time variables resolved before synthesis. Keys are variable names.
build_variables.title: Build Variables

generated_sources.description: Jinja2 templates rendered at build time and added as project sources.
generated_sources.title: Generated Sources

write_hw_platform.description: Options for hardware platform file (.xsa) generation.

BuildConfiguration.title: BuildConfiguration

BuildVariable.description:
A build-time variable resolved before synthesis.

Use `value` for static data or `command` for dynamically computed data.
Exactly one of `value` or `command` must be set.

Example:
```yaml
build_variables:
  version_major:
    value: 1
  git_hash:
    command: "git rev-parse --short HEAD"
  build_date:
    command: "date +%y%m%d"
```

command.description: Shell command to execute. stdout is captured and stripped as the value.
command.title: Command

BuildVariable.title: BuildVariable

Constraint.description:
Constraint file configuration.

Example:
```yaml
constraints:
  - file: timing.xdc
  - file: pins.xdc
    fileset: constrs_1
  - file: debug.xdc
    execution: immediate
    properties:
      USED_IN_SYNTHESIS: false
```

execution.description: Options: `immediate` - Executes the script immediate upon processing it and doesnt add it to the project.
execution.title: Execution

file.description: Path to constraint file (.xdc), relative to config file.
file.title: File

fileset.description: Target fileset (e.g., constrs_1). Defaults to main constraint fileset.
fileset.title: Fileset

properties.description: Additional Vivado properties for the constraint file.
properties.title: Properties

Constraint.title: Constraint

DeviceInfo.description:
FPGA device and board configuration.

Example:
```yaml
device_info:
  part_name: xc7z020clg400-1
  board_name: Arty_Z7_20
  board_part: digilentinc.com:arty-z7-20:part0:1.1
```
DeviceInfo.title: DeviceInfo

GeneratedSource.description:
A Jinja2 template that is rendered at build time and added to the project.

The template has access to the full resolved project configuration
and resolved build variables. Reference values explicitly:
- ``{{ build_variables.version_major }}``
- ``{{ project_information.project_name }}``
- ``{{ project_information.device_info.board_name }}``

Example:
```yaml
generated_sources:
  - template: "hdl/build_info_pkg.vhd.j2"
```

template.description: Path to Jinja2 template file, relative to the YAML config file.
template.title: Template

GeneratedSource.title: GeneratedSource

HooksConfig.description:
TCL hook points for injecting custom commands at lifecycle stages.

Each hook is a list of TCL commands executed at that point in the workflow.
Hooks run inside the Vivado TCL interpreter and have access to the full
Vivado command set plus all project context variables.

Example:
```yaml
hooks:
  post_project_create:
    - "set_property IP_REPO_PATHS /path/to/custom_ips [current_project]"
    - "update_ip_catalog"
  pre_synthesis:
    - 'source "$env(REPO_ROOT)/scripts/pre_synth_checks.tcl"'
  post_implementation:
    - "report_utilization -file utilization.rpt"
  post_bitstream:
    - 'source "$env(REPO_ROOT)/scripts/post_build.tcl"'
```

post_bitstream.description: Run after bitstream generation and artefact packaging.
post_bitstream.title: Post Bitstream

post_project_create.description: Run after project creation and standard property setup.
post_project_create.title: Post Project Create

post_project_setup.description: Run after all project components (sources, constraints, IPs, BDs) are loaded.
post_project_setup.title: Post Project Setup

pre_build.description: Run before the build flow starts (before synthesis).
pre_build.title: Pre Build

HooksConfig.title: HooksConfig

ProjectInformation.description:
Core project identification and settings.

Example:
```yaml
project_information:
  project_name: my_project
  top_level_file_name: top_level
  tool: vivado
  tool_version: "2020.1"
  device_info:
    part_name: xc7z020clg400-1
    board_name: Arty_Z7_20
```

project_name.description: Tool project name. Used for project file and output naming.
project_name.title: Project Name

tool.description: EDA tool to use for this project (e.g., 'vivado').
tool.title: Tool

top_level_file_name.description: Top-level HDL module filename (without path or extension).
top_level_file_name.title: Top Level File Name

ProjectConfiguration.description:
Root project configuration (`hdlproject_project_config.yaml`).

Located in each project directory. This is the top-level model representing
a complete project configuration file.

Example for `synth_options` and `impl_options` - these map directly to
Vivado `set_property` commands:

```yaml
synth_options:
  STEPS.SYNTH_DESIGN.ARGS.FLATTEN_HIERARCHY: rebuilt
  STEPS.SYNTH_DESIGN.ARGS.DIRECTIVE: AreaOptimized_high

impl_options:
  STEPS.OPT_DESIGN.ARGS.DIRECTIVE: Explore
  STEPS.PLACE_DESIGN.ARGS.DIRECTIVE: ExtraNetDelay_high
```

Each generates TCL like:
```tcl
set_property -name STEPS.SYNTH_DESIGN.ARGS.FLATTEN_HIERARCHY -value rebuilt -objects [get_runs synth_1]
```

environment_setup.title: Environment Setup

hdldepends_config.title: Hdldepends Config
